title: The hidden language of psychopathy is not what scientists expected
caption:
Think psychopaths are always cold and emotionless? A new study shows that specific personality traits, like meanness or boldness, actually change how people describe their own lives. It's time to rethink the stereotypes.

Source: Sciencedaily - The hidden language of psychopathy is not what scientists expected
